analysisSummary: Confirmed by reading reflex.py:485-495. The action_map branch executes subprocess.run() but never inspects result.returncode before returning {'success': True}. The `am start` path at line 471 correctly checks returncode. This inconsistency proves the omission is unintentional. On Termux without Termux:API installed, termux-torch would fail non-zero but be reported as success. Expected value check: EV=+4.75 (95% confidence, 5pt medium) — safe to accept.

Confirmed by reflex.py:241-284. go_home, go_back, volume_up, volume_down actions are registered without requires_termux=True (defaults to False). reflex.py:439-442 routes non-Termux actions to _execute_fallback which only simulates. reflex.py:476-483 proves developer intended Termux execution (action_map entries defined) but the flag is missing. All 4 actions silently return desktop simulation on Android. EV=+4.9 (98% confidence, 5pt) — safe to accept.

Confirmed by tracing close_app execution path: reflex.py:121-127 registers close_app with requires_termux=True but no android_action. _execute_termux at line 464 finds pkg=None (skip), line 485 finds 'close_app' not in action_map (skip), line 497 returns success with no-op message. The close_app functionality is completely unimplemented. EV=+4.75 (95% confidence, 5pt) — safe to accept.

Confirmed: decision.py:370 references 'TIMER' intent, but config.py:53-74 does not include TIMER in INTENTS. The _extract_entities branch for number extraction on TIMER is unreachable dead code. This is a cross-file inconsistency between decision.py and config.py. Not a runtime crash but a logic inconsistency. EV=+0.98 (100% confidence, 1pt) — safe to accept.

Confirmed: evaluate.py:45 calls random.shuffle(examples) with no prior random.seed() call. Each evaluation run selects a different 15% test subset, producing different accuracy metrics for the same model on the same dataset. This makes regression testing and model comparison unreliable. EV=+0.8 (90% confidence, 1pt) — safe to accept.

Confirmed: train.py:54 calls random.shuffle(examples) without seed. Training is not reproducible — same code and data produce different models across runs. While the neural network itself also uses random initialization (np.random.randn), adding a seed to split_data would partially improve reproducibility. EV=+0.8 (90% confidence, 1pt) — safe to accept.
